title: Comparison of MR Enteroclysis and MRI With Per Oral Contrast Using a 6 % Mannitol Solution.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare MRI enteroclysis with MRI of the small bowel with a per oral 6%mannitol solution.Our hypothesis is that the peroral technique preform the same way as MRI Enteroclysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* above 18 years
* known Crohns disease or strong suspicion.
* need of a small bowel examination

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant
* electrolyte disturbances.
* Any MRI contraindications.
condition: Magnetic Resonance Imaging, Intestine Small, Crohn Disease.
